scope: same-equation 600 m moving-child versus oversized stationary Nimbus reference with inherited v6 thresholds, geometry, aperture, containment movement, and balanced trusted-containment state

balanced_trusted_containment_amendment.eligibility: every inner-margin-breached axis is an opposing pair whose two faces remain outside the exact relaxation width

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, measurement cadence, and v8 containment-move rules are inherited from the immutable v6 policy chain.
The v6 failure evidence came from a cross-binary checkpoint continuation and is diagnostic-only, not a qualification candidate.
No comparison metric from the invalid v5 candidate or v6 diagnostic probe was inspected or used to alter a threshold.
The balanced state does not admit any relaxation-zone entry and does not waive ambiguity, topology, parent-containment, finite-evidence, or fail-closed trusted-interior checks.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison and does not enable public moving_nest selection or broaden supported physics/backend combinations.
